3_actionable_change.evidence: NOTABLE_CHANGE -> state C; live production payload (SLEEP_DEFICIT) renders conclusion->cause->action with <=3 actions; SMART mode sends exactly one notification on judgment update

4_insufficient_evidence.evidence: INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE -> state D; Q&A returns explicit '目前不能可靠判断 + 缺少的信息' with 0 model calls (test_qna.test_insufficient_evidence_is_explicit)

5_medical_safety.evidence: E precedence in mapping; widget test proves action rendered ABOVE cause for E; sealed medical_trigger policy fires MedGemma-path exactly once on symptom question (PERFORMED); fever correction flips Today to E with conclusion->action->cause order

6_midday_context_update.evidence: POST /context stores USER_REPORTED fact + time meta, then re-evaluates Today (REMATERIALIZED, exactly 1 model call on changed bundle); app Today auto-refreshes on return

7_correction.evidence: PUT /context/{id} supersedes old row (SUPERSEDED + CORRECTION revision, never silent overwrite), new fact wins, Today re-evaluated; test flips state to E

8_overnight_rollover.evidence: deterministic boundary: date advanced AND long sleep ended -> conversation CLOSED with boundary_reason and fresh conversation opened; no rollover before sleep ends (wall-clock-free tests)

9_semantic_stability.evidence: judgment_signature (sha256 over the sealed judgment) gates version creation: identical judgment -> same rendered wording reused verbatim, no new version, no model call (Phase C change-detection tests); renderer is deterministic with no sampling/synonym/model in the render path

10_notification_restraint.evidence: Notification Threshold consulted ONLY on new judgment versions (listener hook); stable/unchanged re-renders produce zero decisions; actionable C update produces exactly one SEND; every SEND/SUPPRESS logged with reason; safety overrides quiet hours

model_call_accounting.detail: 1 controlled DeepSeek call (Phase C real-gate on throwaway copy). MedGemma availability verified via digest-confirmed local Ollama; L7 invokes it only behind the sealed trigger policy. All automated tests use deterministic mock adapters labeled mock-* per contract §61.

known_limitations: Real DeepSeek reasoning summary is English (sealed L6 prompt does not force zh); L7 presents model text verbatim per semantic-stability rule. Forcing zh-CN requires a sealed-L6 prompt change = future interface extension needing layer-owner approval.
Context question budget returns none until a learning loop exists (post-seal roadmap).
OS-level push transport is post-MVP; the in-app feed + decision audit is live. Gate logic is transport-agnostic.
APK is debug-signed; release signing is a distribution task.
Docker not installed on dev PC: final `docker compose up -d --build` runs on the VPS (everything it executes is covered by packaging smoke tests).
History NL search is deterministic keyword match; semantic search is post-seal.
